NEW SECTION . 272C.15A Disqualifications for 22 unlawful presence. 23 A licensing board established after January 1, 1978, and 24 pursuant to the provisions of this chapter, shall not issue or 25 renew a professional license to an individual who the licensing 26 board is unable to verify is lawfully present in the United 27 States, as determined by using the SAVE program clearinghouse. 28 EXPLANATION 29 The inclusion of this explanation does not constitute agreement with 30 the explanation’s substance by the members of the general assembly. 31 This bill relates to qualifications for state employment 32 and professional licensure. The bill requires each head of a 33 department or independent agency of this state, as well as the 34 state board of regents and each regents institution, to use 35 -2- LSB 6908XC (2) 91 ss/ns 2/ 3 S.F. _____ the e-verify system of the U.S. citizenship and immigration 1 services to confirm the employment eligibility of newly hired 2 employees. 3 The bill creates within the department of inspections, 4 appeals, and licensing a clearinghouse to process requests 5 to verify, using the systematic alien verification for 6 entitlements system of the U.S. department of homeland security 7 and the U.S. citizenship and immigration services (SAVE 8 program), the United States citizenship and immigration status 9 of individuals who have applied for a professional license 10 in this state. The bill requires professional licensing 11 boards to use the SAVE program clearinghouse to verify the 12 U.S. citizenship and immigration status of an individual who 13 has applied for a professional license from the board and to 14 decline to issue or renew a license if the licensing board is 15 unable to verify that the person is lawfully present in the 16 United States. The bill requires the denial of an application 17 for a professional license due to the results of the SAVE 18 program clearinghouse check to be appealed to the director of 19 the department of inspections, appeals, and licensing, and 20 the decision of the director shall constitute a final agency 21 action. 22 The bill also requires a licensing board established 23 after January 1, 1978, to adopt rules for the revocation or 24 suspension of a license that the licensing board deems to be 25 a professional license if the licensee is unlawfully present 26 in the United States, as determined by using the SAVE program 27 clearinghouse. 28 -3- LSB 6908XC (2) 91 ss/ns 3/ 3
